name: Gathering Winds
notes:
stacks drop back to 0 after 5s, but adding a stack resets the timer. Offhand weapons do not trigger a stack, only main-hand/two hands using their secondary (right click) ability.

In game (hwp_ran_gathering_winds, tested): a two-handed bow or crossbow secondary attack adds a Tailwind stack: +1% movement, attack and cast speed each, 5 s, refreshed by every stack (assumed). The off-hand crossbow does not count.
summary: Using Bow & Crossbow secondary attacks grants a stack of Tailwind for 5s. Each added stack resets the countdown and increases your Action Speed (Movement, Skill and Weapon Speed) by 1%.
